summary.text: Lee Whiting is the Republican candidate for the Wisconsin State Assembly, District 7, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Democrat Karen Kirsch. He ran for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Lee Whiting ran for the Milwaukee Common Council, District 11, in the nonpartisan primary on February 20, 2024, and received 388 votes (12.0%), finishing third behind Peter Burgelis and Josh Zepnick.
He was the Republican candidate for Wisconsin State Assembly District 7 in the November 5, 2024 general election, when Karen Kirsch defeated him, 58.5% to 41.2%.
Whiting advanced from the Republican primary for the seat on August 11, 2026, receiving 1,676 votes in an uncontested field.
